title: 旧金山数Waymo：一分钟一辆，安全审视跟得上吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So we are heading into San Francisco. I'm going to be interviewing the co-sea of Waymo today.
segments.zh: 我们正前往旧金山。今天我要采访Waymo的联合首席执行官。

segments.en: If you live in San Francisco, you've probably seen Waymo's everywhere.
segments.zh: 如果你住在旧金山，你可能到处都见过Waymo。

segments.en: Google self-driving robo-taxes are taking over their home turf and slowly taking their show on the road across the US and around the world.
segments.zh: 谷歌的自动驾驶出租车正在占领其主场，并逐渐扩展到全美和全球。

segments.en: So we're going to play a little game. It's called Count the Waymo's.
segments.zh: 我们来玩个小游戏，叫数Waymo。

segments.en: Every time we see a Waymo, we're going to count it.
segments.zh: 每看到一辆Waymo，我们就数一下。

segments.en: There's one. One, another one. Two.
segments.zh: 有一辆。一辆，又一辆。两辆。

segments.en: Five. Wonder what this one is doing.
segments.zh: 五辆。想知道这辆在干嘛。

segments.en: Oh no, it's trying to get around this car. It's being very patient.
segments.zh: 哦不，它想绕过这辆车。它很有耐心。

segments.en: Two in a row. Oh my gosh, okay, so that was nine. 10, 11.
segments.zh: 连续两辆。天哪，好吧，那是九辆。十辆，十一辆。

segments.en: Is that another one? 16. Okay, so we've been driving.
segments.zh: 那是另一辆吗？16。好，我们一直在开。

segments.en: I don't know about 15 minutes. We've seen 16 Waymo's, so that's more than a Waymo a minute, which is a lot of Waymo's.
segments.zh: 不知道有没有15分钟。我们已经看到16辆Waymo了，所以每分钟不止一辆Waymo，Waymo可真多。

segments.en: But as Waymo's fleet has grown, so has scrutiny over its safety record.
segments.zh: 但随着Waymo车队规模扩大，对其安全记录的审视也越来越多。

segments.en: Hi, we are currently blocking a train. Driving right past the active police stop.
segments.zh: 嗨，我们目前挡住了一列火车。直接驶过正在进行的警察拦停点。

segments.en: Heavy rainfall, landing Waymo's robo-taxes in hot water.
segments.zh: 强降雨让Waymo的自动驾驶出租车陷入困境。
